seed_policy: Each episode has predeclared physical_seed, observer_seed, auxiliary_seed; same profile/seeds across paired fault hypotheses. No seed selected by performance.
real_oxford_holdout: cell IDs and cycle groups must be frozen before fitting; no fit on these data in stage4
rules: Never split rows of a single battery/time-series across train and test
No model fitting or posterior inference before stage5
Stage4 diagnostic comparisons are not classifier accuracy
Do not tune nuisance parameters on synthetic test episodes
